info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Contact Handler API
info.description: The Contact Handler API facilitates seamless interactions across various banking channels by providing immediate access to contact information related to customer accounts. This API allows businesses to retrieve important contact details needed for customer support, marketing, or account management purposes. Typical use cases include retrieving customer information during service inquiries or enhancing cross-channel communication strategies. It serves as a vital resource for developers working on customer relationship management systems and banking applications.
